sections.name: summary
sections.value: Counter first, extraction second. Every payload key name below is MEASURED from the real specimen, never guessed.

value.title: Add adapters/cursor-tools.ts — a CLOSED registry mapping tool name to extraction strategy
value.notes: Both vocabularies: ApplyPatch (string V4A) and Write/StrReplace (object). Read/Glob/Shell/Grep/Await classified write-free. Absence is the trigger: any unlisted name is unknown.

value.title: Add the read-side honesty counter to session-export.ts
value.notes: Predicate: write-shaped calls > 0 AND file events == 0. Marker uses the EXISTING event_skipped: prefix so acts/telemetry.ts:1372 downgrades the envelope by construction — no gate change, no fence widening. Needs no payload access, so privacy does not arise.

value.title: Pin the Cursor-scoping predicate to the corpus by test
value.notes: Both real fixtures carry harness cursor-agent. A scope gate that silently matches nothing makes the counter quiet — indistinguishable from finding nothing.

value.title: Prove the counter fires on the real 71282df5 shape and stays quiet on both negative controls
value.notes: 2026-06-25-checks-walkthrough also guards registry completeness: if Read/Glob were missing they would classify unknown and fire.

value.title: Add the Write extraction branch
value.notes: input is an OBJECT with keys contents and path — measured from the specimen, not guessed. writtenDelta(contents), change written.

value.title: Add the StrReplace extraction branch
value.notes: input is an OBJECT with keys old_string, new_string, path — measured. computeFileDelta(old,new), change edited.

value.title: Keep same-path handling on array-push
value.notes: NOT claude-adapter Map.set (last-write-wins) and NOT MYOB accumulateFileEvent (does not exist upstream). expected-segment.json bakes this in permanently.

value.title: Mint the golden fixture from the scrubbed specimen
value.notes: scratch/71282df5-scrubbed.jsonl only. Byte-scan verified zero for identity and machine-path strings.

value.title: Add a synthetic drive-letter confinement unit test
value.notes: Scrubbing rebases the drive letter away, so the fixture cannot carry it. No real machine data needed.

value.title: Add the AC-04 privacy assertion over the new branches
value.notes: contents, old_string and new_string are full file text; consumed only inside the delta helpers, never retained.

value.title: Prove non-vacuity — each new assertion goes RED when its branch is removed
Update the blind-spot list in docs/how/measuring-ai-contribution.md
value.notes: Its own warning — adding a new agent tool that writes files requires updating this list — is precisely what went wrong.
